title: Surplus Funds Recovery Operator Companion Workbook
subtitle: 6 Field Worksheets, Lien-Priority Calculators & 30-Day Execution Logs

worksheets.title: County List and Statute Screen
worksheets.purpose: Select two evidence-backed pilot counties and distinguish their tax-sale and foreclosure claim routes before acquisition spending.
instructions: Complete one record per county and sale route; never transfer tax-deed assumptions into a mortgage-foreclosure file.
Attach the official inventory and current forms, then extract each rule with its source, retrieval date, and unresolved questions.
Compare eligible inventory, record accessibility, counsel coverage, and deadlines; explain why the chosen pair outranks alternatives.

Cross-reference the same master file ID across all six worksheets. Worksheet 1 owns the 20-State Tier and post-Tyler notice matrix; worksheet 2 owns Clerk Registry balance verification; worksheet 4 owns cold-call objections and trigger-mail responses; worksheet 5 owns the eight-exhibit attorney handoff; worksheets 3 and 6 own cohort calculations and reconciliation respectively. Reference those source records here rather than creating conflicting copies.

For each applicable file, resolve Tier-1 administrative versus Tier-2 judicial-motion routing, preserve the actual statutory notice and deadline evidence, and distinguish Tyler v. Hennepin County from the controlling state procedure. For Michigan, record the applicable MCL 211.78t subsection and foreclosure-year July 1 notice cutoff separately from the subsequent motion window; flag historical-sale exceptions for counsel review.

Reconcile Track 01 ledger sourcing with Track 02 trigger-mail, comparison-calculator, and inbound quiz-bridge attribution using one primary cohort per case. Use collected firm fees, actual allocated costs, and equal-age cohorts; exclude claimant funds and unpaid pipeline from realized ROI. Document missing evidence and zero denominators explicitly.

fields.field_label: 20-State Tier and Tyler notice matrix reference
fields.guidance: Link worksheet 1's twenty-state research rows: state, county, sale route, Tier-1 or Tier-2, statutory section and effective version, official source, notice trigger, service evidence, claimant response cutoff, motion deadline, reviewer, and unresolved applicability. Cite Tyler v. Hennepin County, 598 U.S. 631 (2023), separately from state authority. For MCL 211.78t distinguish the applicable foreclosure-year July 1 notice and following-year motion dates. Mark unresearched entries unresolved, not nationwide coverage. Include public-record request batch ID, custodian, date range, state-law or court-record route, cost estimate, response status, and missing records; federal FOIA does not govern county records.

fields.field_label: Clerk Registry balance-verification phone log reference
fields.guidance: Link worksheet 2's call log: file and case ID, official telephone source, office, staff contact, call date and time, stated balance and as-of date, pending disbursements, competing claims reported, written-record request, corroborating document, discrepancy, and next owner. Script: 'What amount remains in the registry for this case as of today, and where can I obtain the supporting record?' Keep phone information provisional until corroborated; the balance alone does not establish entitlement.

fields.field_label: Cold-call objection-rebuttal and trigger-mail response tracker reference
fields.guidance: Link worksheet 4 by case and campaign ID. Record channel, script version, objection verbatim, response used, verified recipient, follow-up, suppression, mailed and delivered dates, return reason, and attributable reply. Script: 'We are a private firm, not the county. You may verify the record and file directly; our proposal explains our optional service fee.' Score private identity, official verification, direct filing option, fee accuracy, and absence of payout promises; QA pass rate equals interactions passing every criterion divided by audited interactions. Show sample count and unavailable for no audits. Distinguish mail, calculator, and quiz assists without duplicating engagements.

Link worksheet 5's versioned exhibit index: 1 registry balance and sale; 2 vesting and legal description; 3 interests and waterfall; 4 identity and authority; 5 bankruptcy review; 6 notices and deadline calculations; 7 executed service and representation documents; 8 route-specific claim or motion and required service evidence. For each record source, date, reviewer, complete/missing/not-applicable status, and reason. Add county-specific requirements. Reference the signed term sheet naming client, lead and local attorneys, scope, permitted separate compensation, expense payer, replacement duties, and per-state acknowledgment, deficiency, draft, and filing SLAs. Nonlawyer administrative services are not attorney co-counsel representation.

fields.field_label: Track 01 + Track 02 cohort ROI reconciliation reference
fields.guidance: Link worksheet 3 calculations and worksheet 6 reconciliation by cohort start date, as-of date, unique case ID, primary source, and assisted channels. Record actual channel spend, allocated labor, firm-borne counsel and servicing costs, screened files, qualified contacts, engagements, filings, paid files, and bank-supported collected fees. Contribution equals collected firm fees minus acquisition and servicing costs; ROI equals contribution divided by those total costs. Count each cost once, document allocation method, label zero-cost ROI unavailable, and show unpaid pipeline separately. Reconcile channel totals to unique cases and the bank ledger; compare cohorts at equal age and record differences, owners, and resolution dates.
Name the administering office and distinguish tax deed, tax-defaulted sale, and mortgage foreclosure.
Record URL, retrieval date, list date, file reference, and count of unique balances at least $15,000.
Record section, official URL, retrieval date, and the precise rule supported; identify unresolved interpretation.
Record applicable fee cap and base, assignment restrictions, and counsel's source-backed interpretation; unknown is not unrestricted.
Record triggering event, calculation method, actual deadline, authority, and reminder dates separately.
List current form versions, identity evidence, required exhibits, filing location, and receipt method.
Record licensed attorney, relevant state coverage, engagement scope, permissible compensation arrangement, and signed date.
Compare volume and record quality; name the reviewer, spending ceiling, remaining questions, and next review date.

completion_checklist: Two counties have dated official inventory evidence.
Sale routes, fee rules, waiting periods, and deadlines are separately documented.
Current clerk forms and applicable counsel coverage are attached.
Unresolved rules have owners rather than guessed answers.

worksheets.title: Chain of Title and Lien Waterfall
worksheets.purpose: Connect a surplus account to a supported claimant and calculate provisional equity without confusing recorded interests with resolved priority.
instructions: Create one sheet per file and attach the source instruments, not just a commercial title summary.
Build a chronological vesting chain, then a separate counsel-reviewed priority waterfall; chronology alone does not decide legal priority.
Mark disputed interests and missing releases explicitly. Recalculate low and high equity estimates when unresolved claims change.

fields.field_label: File, parcel, case, and sale identifiers
fields.guidance: Match the legal description and sale account; document any identifier mismatch.
Enter dollars and attach the official balance evidence and as-of date.
Record index, search period, name variations, query dates, and instrument references for each link.
Identify entitlement date, owner, conveyances, probate appointment, trust capacity, or entity authority evidence.
For each mortgage, judgment, tax lien, or other interest, record amount, holder, recording number, release, and unresolved effect.
List allowed claims in distribution order with legal basis and reviewer; distinguish disputed from established amounts.
Start with verified surplus; subtract supported superior distributions and authorized costs once. Show claimant allocations and uncertain ranges separately.
Record PACER identifiers, query date, case matches, counsel review, trustee issues, and refresh date; no-match is not conclusive clearance.
Advance, investigate, or decline; name the unresolved evidence, owner, deadline, and spending ceiling.

completion_checklist: Vesting instruments and legal description match the surplus account.
Each potential surviving interest has evidence and a disposition.
Priority assumptions and bankruptcy questions are reviewed by counsel.
Equity ranges exclude unsupported or duplicate deductions.

worksheets.title: Net Surplus and Fee Calculator
worksheets.purpose: Separate claimant recovery, lawful firm fees, file contribution, and reserve coverage using auditable manual calculations.
instructions: Copy only dated, supported amounts from the title waterfall. These are calculation fields, not an automated legal-priority engine.
Calculate claimant allocation after superior distributions, then apply the supported contractual fee basis and applicable restrictions.
Keep claimant-borne expenses separate from firm-borne costs and reconcile every deduction to avoid double counting.

Enter S in dollars with evidence date; a posted list balance may require refresh.
Itemize L and K with sources; provisional available equity is max(0, S - L - K). Flag any unresolved priority.
Enter A after supported competing-owner shares; explain allocation evidence and low/high scenarios.

fields.field_label: Permitted fee basis and contractual terms
fields.guidance: Specify dollar or percentage terms, fee base B, and source-backed cap if applicable. Do not assume every jurisdiction permits the same base.
For a permitted percentage contract compute F = B x rate, limited by applicable rules and contract. Distinguish estimated, earned, and collected F.
Compute A minus claimant-paid F and any separately authorized claimant expenses not already deducted; explain any negative result rather than concealing it.
Compute collected F minus firm-borne acquisition and servicing costs. Track expected contribution separately using explicit collection assumptions.
Divide actual acquisition spend by screened files, verified contacts, engagements, and filed claims separately; use unavailable for zero denominators.
List unrestricted cash, committed case costs, and dated operating outflows. Exclude unpaid fees; compute remaining cash and coverage under delayed collections.

completion_checklist: Fees are not calculated on an unsupported posted balance.
Every cost is assigned once to the proper payer.
Claimant net, firm fee, and firm contribution remain distinct.
Cash coverage survives the documented collection-delay scenario.

worksheets.title: Skip-Trace and Outreach Log
worksheets.purpose: Document supported identity matching, transparent contact, and communication quality for the top twelve candidates.
instructions: Open one log per claimant; keep sensitive identifiers in the restricted repository and reference them by file ID here.
Record each contact attempt with channel, time, script version, outcome, and next action. Suppress wrong parties and declined contact across channels.
Audit actual statements against the verification packet; preserve recordings only when recording requirements are satisfied.

Reference representative authority evidence and counsel's dated disposition of relevant PACER results.
Reference official source, private-firm identity, direct filing option, fee basis, costs, and uncertainties.
Record timestamp, channel, verified recipient, script version, outcome, and permitted next contact.
Record applicable recording requirements and obtained consent where needed; otherwise use contemporaneous notes.
Distinguish questions, interest, agreement, refusal, wrong party, and no response; record suppression actions.
Identify exact inaccurate statement, corrected wording, reviewer, claimant follow-up, and completion date.

completion_checklist: Identity and signing authority are supported before execution.

worksheets.title: Claim Packet, Notary and Counsel QC
worksheets.purpose: Produce a complete, traceable execution and filing package while separating real submissions from training rehearsals.
instructions: Use the current county-route checklist and counsel's file-specific requirements; document deviations rather than silently omitting exhibits.
Review execution before submission and retain the actual receipt. If unsigned, rehearse with labeled synthetic or redacted documents and do not submit.
After filing, preserve deficiencies and aging events without resetting the original acceptance date.

completion_checklist: Current forms, authority, and required exhibits are complete.
Execution defects are corrected before submission.
Real filings have receipts; rehearsals are labeled and unsubmitted.
Aging owner, next event, and claimant update are assigned.

worksheets.title: Thirty-Day Surplus Execution Log
worksheets.purpose: Connect every pilot day to a saved deliverable and make the Day-30 decision from actual evidence and cash exposure.
instructions: Create one daily row for days 1-30 using Q12's roadmap; record planned output, actual output, evidence reference, spending, and unresolved owner.
Reconcile weekly totals without counting the same file twice. Report shortfalls rather than weakening underwriting thresholds.
At day thirty, record Continue, Revise, or Stop and preserve existing claimant-service obligations regardless of acquisition decisions.
